findings.problem: Waiting until lock+24min reserves 6min, less than all three observed full U13 recoveries (447.7..479.0s). The identical rollback/321 identity/recovery smoke/final sequence can exceed the strict 30min window after signature timeout.

findings.problem: Admission reads summarized Mac/VM gate receipts and u7_executor.policy_binding but omits executor native_tickets/assert_unchanged. Native exceptions/checker bytes are bound by deployment_native_gate.binding, not u7_executor.policy_binding. The Stage A backend checks these tickets; Stage B hook bypasses that backend admission.
findings.impact: Production executor still recomputes native gates before deployment, so this is a pre-lock freshness gap rather than a demonstrated bypass. Stale offline proof can pass dispatcher and only be detected/recomputed after LOCK.
findings.requested_change: Read each full executor receipt, require deployable/gates_passed and assert_unchanged on candidate+baseline native tickets before LOCK, as Stage A does.
